features: Distinct invoice count per customer/item; sublinear TF, smoothed IDF and SVD fitted at first origin only; L2 normalized SVD features. RFM excluded from preference features. All countries, positive merchandise transactions with known customers.

graph.edges: union of positive-cosine kNN, undirected max weight; self edges excluded

selection: No method or hyperparameter is selected using future outcomes. KMeans K=4 is fixed; additional KMeans uses the observed primary Leiden group count to control group-count differences, not to optimize outcomes.
stability: Refit clustering on fixed first-origin feature representation; 80% subsamples compared only on included customers. ARI including noise and ARI on jointly assigned customers are separate. Second-origin refits all preference clusterers with frozen vocabulary/IDF/SVD; temporal ARI is not fixed-model migration or accuracy.
future: Freeze assignments and historical top-10 representative items before reading 30-day purchases. On each method's assigned returning customers compare group top-10 with global top-10; all future items remain in denominator. Report noise/unknown-catalog exclusions. This is profile continuation, not personalized recommendation or causal marketing uplift.
